title: Difficulty
description: The rules that change with the difficulty picked for a new game (row = the game's difficulty 0 to 3). The game computes these from the difficulty in its code; the rows hold the results so mods can reshape the curve. Money is in units of $100; a game month is 1024 ticks.

start_cash.description: Cash of a new standard game, in $100. The land is bought from it, so it also decides which properties are affordable.

wage_period.description: Ticks between two wage and hole upkeep charges (the game uses 1024 / (difficulty + 2)).

start_mood.description: Lowest mood of a golfer arriving at the course (mood runs from -10 to 10; below -10 a golfer leaves).

start_mood_random.description: A random 0 to this is added to start_mood.

hole_fatigue.description: Weight of the mood drop after each hole (the game uses difficulty + 1).
